summary: Re-tested FINAL bug #1: success → /transfer/auction redirect. The recap.tsx fix (moving redirect into useEffect) is APPLIED but INSUFFICIENT. Bug STILL PRESENT. Root cause: /app/frontend/app/transfer/details.tsx has the SAME render-time `router.replace('/transfer/new')` pattern (lines 29-32) that was supposedly removed from recap.tsx. When success.tsx unmounts and clears the draft, details.tsx (still mounted in the Expo Router stack) re-renders, sees `!draft`, and fires the redirect during render — hijacking the navigation to /transfer/auction. Confirmed by the React warning captured in browser console: `Cannot update a component (NavigationContainerInner) while rendering a different component (TransferStep2 ./transfer/details.tsx)`. Also fixed a missing `useEffect` import in recap.tsx that would have crashed the screen.

ui_bugs.issue: Render-side `router.replace('/transfer/new')` at lines 29-32. Same anti-pattern that was already fixed in recap.tsx — must be moved to useEffect so it doesn't race with success.tsx's draft-clear on unmount.
FIXED by me: `useEffect` was used (line 25) but missing from the React import (line 1). Bundler error / runtime crash. Added useEffect to import.

integration_issues.flow: Confirm PIN → /transfer/success → tap 'Voir les enchères' (testID=success-continue) → expected /transfer/auction
integration_issues.issue: Observed: instantly redirected to /transfer/new (within 500 ms, never reaches auction screen). Auction screen never mounts — no LIVE badge, no timer, no WebSocket bids. Reproduced 100% (1/1).

action_items: Optional belt-and-braces: in success.tsx, call clearDraft() AFTER router.replace (or inside a setTimeout/post-navigation hook) instead of inside the unmount cleanup. This way the draft is not nulled while details.tsx / recap.tsx are still mounted in the Expo Router stack. Currently `return () => clearDraft();` (line 25) runs the moment success unmounts, which is exactly when navigation to /transfer/auction starts.

After fix, re-run this same E2E flow: login → /transfer/new (SN, 100 EUR, cash, Mariam Diallo) → /transfer/details (Famille/Soutien + Salaire) → /transfer/recap → PIN 123456 → /transfer/success (verify 10-digit code visible) → tap success-continue → MUST stay on /transfer/auction with LIVE badge and 90s timer.
critical_code_review_comments: Render-side `router.replace` is an anti-pattern in React/Expo Router and triggers the React 'setState during render' warning. All transfer/* steps that depend on `draft` should guard via useEffect, not in the render body.
PINPad component testID convention is `pinpad-key-{digit}` (not `pinpad-{digit}`); kept as note for future testing agents.

rca_of_issue: Reproduction (100%): login → /transfer/new → SN/100 EUR/cash/Mariam Diallo → Continuer → /transfer/details → Famille/Soutien + Salaire → 'Voir le récapitulatif' → /transfer/recap → 'Confirmer avec mon PIN' → 123456 → Valider → /transfer/success (10-digit code 2495498087 displayed correctly) → tap testID=success-continue → page jumps to /transfer/new within ~500 ms instead of /transfer/auction. Browser console emits: `Cannot update a component (NavigationContainerInner) while rendering a different component (TransferStep2 ./transfer/details.tsx)`. Mechanism: success.tsx's useEffect cleanup calls clearDraft() on unmount → Zustand store updates → details.tsx (still mounted in the Expo Router stack underneath /success) re-renders → its render body executes `if (!draft) { router.replace('/transfer/new'); return null; }` → router.replace fires SYNCHRONOUSLY during render, racing with and overriding the success.tsx → /transfer/auction navigation. Mitigation: move the redirect into useEffect in details.tsx (same pattern already applied to recap.tsx). Optionally also call clearDraft() in success.tsx's goNext() AFTER the router.replace, not in the unmount cleanup.
